answers.moment: him looking down at his phone while i talked

av_event.line_text: Ryan: That's actually dead clever. That's a skill, that. Most people'd just see a pair of shoes. I wouldn't have a clue. Hannah, my wife, says I dress like a geography teacher, which is an insult I've never recovered from.
av_event.what: While Ryan is talking, Liam's eyes drop below the camera to his lap three or four times, and the bluish light on his face brightens briefly as if a phone screen has lit up. He looks back up at the screen each time after a second or two.
